technical_and_design_decisions: Preserve the existing Spring XD module, shell, registry, Flo, and stream-lifecycle architecture and implement the increment using the project's established Java and build conventions.
Move the gpfdist Project Reactor sink into the core module set, retaining its existing message contract and configuration behavior while updating packaging, wiring, and documentation.

Implement the centralized module registry as a GitHub-backed repository with module artifacts and metadata committed through the existing registry upload flow; use configurable repository, branch, credentials, and polling or refresh behavior.

Implement HDFS as the default remote location for custom module registry artifacts, while retaining explicit configuration overrides for other locations and removing the custom-modules.zip artifact from the YARN distribution.

Use the existing JavaMail and Spring Integration mail adapter configuration model, exposing java-mail-properties so users can provide SSL, TLS, protocol, socket-factory, and debugging properties without hard-coding security settings.

Implement shell auto-configuration through an initialization script mechanism that executes supported configuration commands at shell startup or on explicit initialization, with command ordering and failure reporting preserved.

Implement graceful undeployment as a drain operation: stop accepting new work, allow in-flight messages to complete through the sink, enforce a configurable timeout, and fall back to the existing shutdown or dead-letter behavior when the timeout expires.

Benchmark RabbitMQ using repeatable producer, consumer, throughput, latency, and scale-out scenarios across increasing numbers of xd-container nodes, with infrastructure-specific results separated from software correctness tests.
Use automated unit, integration, regression, and acceptance tests where practical, and update operational and user documentation for all externally visible configuration or lifecycle changes.
assumptions: The work targets an existing Spring XD-era codebase represented by the user stories; the general Spring Framework description does not require upgrading the project to Spring Framework 6 or Java 17.
The developer has access to the source repositories, build environment, CI system, required dependent services, and representative existing tests.
The gpfdist module already has a substantially working implementation in the spring-xd-modules repository and does not require redesigning the GPDB or HAWQ sink protocol.
A GitHub repository, credentials, permissions, and a suitable branch strategy can be provisioned without implementing a new GitHub service or organization-management workflow.
HDFS, RabbitMQ, YARN, IMAP, and SMTP test environments are available; environment provisioning and long-term operations are excluded except for test scripts and configuration.
The RabbitMQ benchmark produces an engineering report and repeatable scripts rather than a production capacity guarantee or a formal performance certification.
The existing shell command parser and script executor can be extended without replacing the command-line framework.

Graceful shutdown applies to stream undeployment and existing message-channel or container lifecycle abstractions; exactly-once delivery, arbitrary custom-module cooperation, and indefinite draining are out of scope.
Backward compatibility is required for existing registry, mail, shell, and stream configurations unless a new default is explicitly requested by the stories.

Effort includes implementation, code review preparation, automated testing, documentation, and local integration debugging, but excludes elapsed waiting time for external approvals or infrastructure availability.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing repositories, module layout, registry providers, shell initialization, Flo parser endpoints, mail adapters, stream lifecycle, build profiles, and test conventions; map each story to affected components and define acceptance checks.

activities.activity_name: Migrate gpfdist Reactor sink into core
activities.activity_description: Move or adapt the Project Reactor-based gpfdist sink, update dependencies and module packaging, integrate configuration and metadata, preserve compatibility with GPDB/HAWQ usage, and add unit and integration coverage for successful writes and failure handling.

Add GitHub-backed registry storage and upload behavior, including repository and branch configuration, authentication, artifact and metadata handling, synchronization or refresh behavior, error handling, and tests for reads, uploads, and repository failures.

Create repeatable benchmark scripts and deployment configurations, exercise RabbitMQ with increasing xd-container counts, collect throughput, latency, resource, and failure observations, and analyze and document the results.

activities.activity_name: Improve Flo parser endpoints and error reporting
activities.activity_description: Review current parser endpoint failures, define a consistent error response and diagnostic strategy, implement endpoint and parser changes, preserve valid-input behavior, and add malformed-input, validation, and regression tests.

activities.activity_name: Secure IMAP and SMTP mail configuration
activities.activity_description: Enable mail source and sink configuration through java-mail-properties, support SSL and TLS protocol and socket-factory properties, validate configuration propagation and secure connections, and add tests and examples for IMAPS, SMTPS, and STARTTLS-style configurations.

activities.activity_name: Default custom module registry to HDFS
activities.activity_description: Change the default remote custom-module registry location to HDFS, support direct shell and REST uploads, update configuration and startup behavior, remove custom-modules.zip from the YARN distribution, and test compatibility and migration behavior.

Implement automatic discovery or execution of environment initialization commands, support the documented xd-shell.init format and command ordering, provide useful diagnostics for invalid or unreachable targets, and add startup and script-execution tests.

Design and implement stream drain semantics for in-flight messages, coordinate source, channels, processors, and sinks during undeployment, add configurable timeout and fallback behavior, and test completion, timeout, failure, and dead-letter scenarios.

Run the complete build and affected integration suites, test interactions among registry providers, shell configuration, module deployment, secure mail, migrated gpfdist modules, and lifecycle behavior, fix regressions, and perform compatibility verification.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, release configuration, and final packaging
activities.activity_description: Update user, operator, and developer documentation; add configuration examples and migration notes; update distribution manifests and release metadata; perform final packaging checks and prepare the increment for review and release.
